reviews.x: I made my own vanilla and will be straining it into these little bottles. They are the perfect size and my friends will love it.
Love this set.  Very convenient for my turmeric/ginger shots.  Just the perfect size.

I collect and sample whisky quite often and these little 2 ounce pours are great for on the go or trading samples with friends. I used to go to the Container Store to buy their 1 ounce ones but you really cannot beat these but i found the glass to be a tad too thin and unreliable. These have a much more sturdy glass with a cap that will not leak. I've thrown these into my luggage or backpack and never have to worry about them spilling or breaking.  I will buy again and again.
Such high quality beautiful glass bottles I use them for gifts for my apothecaries.  Lid is leak proof.  Will buy over and over.  Labels adhere nicely.

I’m very impressed with these jars. Makes or a perfect little bottle to give people samples of my hot sauce. Would highly recommend for an application like that. The glass seems to be pretty good quality and the lids all screw on tight and are water sealed.

I bought these (and a cute little funnel) to take home extra wine from my wine tasting class. Of course, that was before I learned that the course had a rule against taking the wine off campus, so they only got to be used for that purpose once. Sadness.  In any case, they have since been used to take a day's worth of soy milk to work for my coffee. I imagine they'd be great for a large number of tasks. They do not leak (even when on their side in my purse -- thank goodness) and they are relative

reviews.t: Love the bottles but you can’t freeze them
reviews.x: I love the bottles but......I made ginger turmeric shots and put in the freezer to last up to four days and all the jars cracked.

reviews.t: Makes taking my daily greens so easy!
reviews.x: These are so great! I prep for 12 work days at a time and keep them in my pantry. Every day I grab one as I walk out the door. It makes making sure I’m taking my greens first thing in the morning so easy! I get to the office, add water, shake, drink and rinse. Back into my work bag it goes so I can take it home to clean it. Then I have my coffee and I know I started my day off with the best thing for me. Having it as a meal prep item every two weeks is a great way to keep me on track! Just a lit

reviews.t: These are nice, sturdy little bottles perfect for carrying around small ...
reviews.x: These are nice, sturdy little bottles perfect for carrying around small amounts of liquid.  I haven't had any trouble with leaking yet (and I am using these to hold black liquid ink, so I'd know if any were escaping).
Good quality durable bottle. Lids twist on easily and creat a great seal.

Easy to fill with a small funnel. Good quality for the price. Lids fit perfectly and screws on for safe travel. I used these for home made maple syrup and they even held up from days of sitting in the bottom of my purse.

These are the perfect size for my clay masks! had to purchase funnels since the opening is small...because the bottle is small..but it's not an issue. I will definitely be purchasing more of them in the future.
I used them for my home made vanilla and they were perfect, put cute little stickers on them and gave them for Christmas presents. They hold 2 oz of liquid. I will probably order more.
Used these for vanilla extract. They were perfect

I bought these with the intention of freezing ginger turmeric shots. The nutritional benefits fade after 48 hours in the fridge so instead of making them every two days I got these bottles. I had read in another review someone had done the same and defrosted them in the fridge the night before. Maybe I over filled them and that’s why 10 of the twelve broke but I’m super sad!!! I wasted time and money. I am going to just freeze in ice trays from now on no cute little bottles ☹️
Works great for my purposes. Using them as drams for scotch to share with friends. Don't leak, don't smell, work great!
Used to bottle homemade vanilla extract. Great gift giving. Items received as described.
Nice quality, perfect size for extremely hot sauce
perfect for my vanilla bean extract gifts

I have been looking for these small bottles for charms. These are the perfect size and perfect shape to be placed in a hand bag if I will give my project charms to friends. Recommendable products . Please tell your delivery guy to place the package by the main door and not near the steps for possible theft. Please see the picture he took. Some days good delivery and some days it is a high risk that other can take my package. Thank you.

I like the quality of the glass and the design. I used them for a little bit of water that I brought back from Rome a month ago. The water was from the basement (two, excavated levels below the current church) of San Clemente. The water runs through the original aqueducts into the Roman villa that was under the church! So, I wanted nice looking bottles and strong.

reviews.t: Small mouth, lid sometimes sticks, overall does the job
reviews.x: There is a clear plastic insert in the lid, which sometimes sticks to the glass when opened. The mouth of these is so small- I should have thought to look for larger-mouthed bottles for my juicing. They do the job though and are easily washable. I rinse as soon as I finish my juice to avoid dried-on particles.

I bought a bundle of vanilla beans, and have a series of one-bean vanilla extracts going for beer making. It's a great way to have small batches on hand, long term for such endeavors. you could easily get two vanilla beans per bottle, maybe even three, and cover with vodka.

reviews.t: Little glass bottles are what I needed.
reviews.x: I bought these little bottles to fill up my little concotions that I make. It's cheaper than to buy it from the store. The units are about the right size. Maybe a 2.5oz would be good. I forget what the dang TSA limits are. I would give it 5 stars if it came with labels too.
I literally only needed 2 bottles, but ordered this since I couldn't find just 2. When I received them there were no lids, so I can even use them. Now I'm stuck with 12 useless glass bottles.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bottles as the perfect size for small batches and samples.
Many customers consider these bottles a great value and good quality for the price.
The lids are commonly described as sealing tightly and being leak proof.
Several reviewers report the bottles crack when used for freezing.
